        print(f"Player is inside sky blue object {s['id']}")

# Check adjacency
adj = seg['adjacency_list']
print(f"\nAdjacency pairs involving player ({player['id']}):")
for a in adj:
    if player['id'] in a:
        other_id = a[0] if a[1] == player['id'] else a[1]
        other = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['id'] == other_id][0]
        print(f"  Player adjacent to: color={other['color']}, boundary={other['boundary'][:4]}")

# Try RIGHT to see if blue door moves back
action(['RIGHT'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
